storage.v2_routes: Immutable trusted context; exact 8-byte big-endian high/confirmed/retired frontiers; prefix roots, latest encrypted receiver retirement checkpoint evidence and revocation.
storage.v2_requests: Permanent mapping (context_hash,request_key) to operation, requested TTL and assigned derived delivery ID.
storage.v2_outbox: Exactly one row per existing L3 delivery ticket; immutable canonical descriptor, unsigned seq, state and purpose-separated encrypted envelope/control/fact/receipt.
storage.v2_retire_offers: Encrypted immutable signed offers keyed by context/base/target. Sender archives and request mappings retained, no global storage bound.
storage.schema: Exact built-in v2 table definitions checked at open/recovery; no implicit legacy migration. Full state remains subject to generic 16 MiB witness image cap.

invariants: Within one sender-authority transaction, resolve or bind stable admission key before allocating sequence; L3 ticket, request mapping, descriptor, outbox and route high-water commit together.

Fresh admission and public admission retry both preserve current root/credential/key, recipient, publication, profile and route-revocation checks. Exact retry never renews original expiry; changed operation/TTL conflicts.

Old already-admitted envelope preparation follows original ticket lifetime after root/credential revocation, while route revocation blocks transmission preparation. Post-expiry terminal control can reconcile old work even after route/root revocation.

Complete result is read from the existing COMMITTED authenticated-encrypted operation and bound to original descriptor/ticket; signed envelope stored before return. No new sampling or accounting reset.
Only exact previously prepared signed body can support confirmation. Duplicate fact accepted; any different fact, including another valid signed first-event time, conflicts.
Confirmation facts and contiguous prefix advancement persist together before retirement signing is admitted. Offer target cannot exceed authoritative confirmed frontier.

Retirement response is verified against stored offer or signed checkpoint query and sender archive; receiver high-water cannot exceed sender admissions. Latest signed request/reply evidence persists with retired frontier/root.
Recovery validates v2 schema, coverage, canonical descriptor, original encrypted result/evidence, confirmed/retired roots and signed checkpoint before local recovery commit.
ordering: ReferenceWitness/authorized TLS witness CAS accepts full next image before local anchor/local commit, and before methods return wire bytes. Unknown authority outcome fences stale copies until exact recovery.
unsigned_sequences: Fixed 8-byte big-endian BLOB with typeof/length constraints; byte ordering is numeric ordering. Allocation at 2^64-1 rejects rather than wraps. Boundary fixture did not generate or audit 2^64-1 historical operations.
authority_assumptions: Reference witness and TLS service must be linearizable and nonrollback. Same-host test services do not prove independent production failure domains. All signing keys/inputs synthetic. API is trusted internal driver, not public authenticated management endpoint.

validation.crash_transport: Reference witness process cuts only; separate TLS success fixture does not establish TLS crash-cut coverage.
validation.mixed_fixture: Signed encrypted shared-account B4 N3 histogram and count jobs, complete original results, sender admission/preparation/evidence integration.
validation.receiver_evidence: This sender suite uses synthetic signed receiver facts/checkpoints. Separate retention_recipient_test_results.json validates actual recipient transactions and loopback result/control/retirement transport.
races: same request maps to one identity
competing local clones: at most one witness CAS commits
negative_controls: invalid authoritative prefix image rejected before recovery commit
injected validly signed but wrong stored terminal binding rejected
full uint64 allocator exhaustion simulated at boundary only
